This week, my average daily caloric intake was 970 cal. I met my goal of consume 800 - 1200 cal a day except for on Saturday. I went to a friend's birthday party that was hosted by a baker.

I ate only a salad with balsamic vinegar for lunch on Saturday for 100 cal so that I could minimize the impact of eating at the party. I also went for a short jog to use up a little bit more calories as well. It was a soup party so I did have some decent choices like matzo ball soup and chicken gumbo but between the cake, cupcakes, and cake pops, I still had 1350 cal for the day. I had tried to keep my cal count low for the week so that I could eat freely at the party and I think I did ok, not good. I did eat less cal than I expected though.

According to my logging site, I've used 9,324 more cal than I ate. This should translate to 2.66 lbs. of real weight lose. I appear to have only lost 1.8 lbs. but that might be due to the fact that I overate Saturday night and then weighed myself Sunday morning. I think next week will have a slightly higher weight loss.

I have started to throw in some different meals since I was already getting burned out on the same meals. Some nights, we had grilled eggplant and chicken breast, and we also found these microwave Indian dishes that are only 300 cal that we'll eat on rice. I have also found that mixing some chicken bouillon with water can be used for frying things instead of oil. This allows me to make a stir fry that's not too bad in cal.

I've gone on short 1-mile jogs three times this week and plan to keep on it. I found a weight vest that I bought years ago and will start jogging with it. Our pit-bull doesn't want to run as much as either of us so this can help tire me out faster so I'm not dragging the dog around.

The desserts in our house have been slowly decreasing. Because my cal intake would often be sub 800, I often had a dessert at night, partly to get rid of it and partly to reward myself for not snacking or eating high cal food. I had a dessert 5 of the nights. I found a pint of "ice cream" that was 150 cal for the whole pint so we split that over 2 days. It was a flavor-less disappointment. I learned to not bother with diet/healthy desserts, at least not frozen ones. My worst day for cal intake was Saturday at 1326, due to the birthday party. My best day was 773 cal(including a dessert), a little lower than I like but I knew that I had the party coming and wanted to make as much room as I could for it.

I have several hurdles coming up. My fiancee wants to go a bar this week for their trivia night and a friend of ours wants to go to a Mexican restaurant this month cause they have a coupon. Both of these places have the potential to wreck my cal count. My company will be providing another breakfast this week and I will need to have better control of myself. I also have a trip coming up at the end of the month and wont be in control there. I have been trying to keep my daily count below 950 so when I do have social engagements, I'm not suffering too bad if I do go over.

Failures:

* Went over my limit at a party

I have signed up for a Half Mudder in May which is basically a 5 mile obstacle course, This is about half from now to our wedding and should help provide motivation for our success or shame and embarrassment for failing(which should kick us back into our weight loss again). I plan to start weightlifting in February as well as increasing my daily calorie intake at the same time.

My weight is now at a 9 year low and the amount of fat that I can grab at my stomach has decreased since this started. I am beginning to see some feint outlines of muscle on my arms, but that might just be me imaging it. I am content with my current weight loss and hope to get to 185 lbs. in no more than 4 weeks. I think I can do it 3 weeks if I am not too bad on the trip.
